description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring Aliyar Sabeer was selected as a member of the Mannar P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically operates under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a new member through a political party nomination process. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
